answer: Reputation drops 4 percent per epoch with no graded task, and a failed audit slashes 30 percent of the stake at the same close. Replaying an old answer counts as a failed audit, so a relic from epoch 5 is worth nothing at epoch 12. One honest submission per epoch holds the score flat. The cheapest attack needs a fresh answer, a funded stake, and a pass from 3 of 5 seats. That floor sits above the 0.3 SOL a thousand idle clones would net, so the nectar of a clone farm dries up and work pays better. A whisper of activity no longer resets the clock.
